Organic Pumpkin Scones
By: BigFatBaker
Published: Sunday, January 15, 2012 - 11:14pm

Ingredients




2 cups organic flour
1/3 cup organic brown sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tsp ginger
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
1 stick (1/2 cup) cold unsalted organic butter, cut into small cubes
1/2 cup mini chocolate chips
1/3 cup buttermilk
1/2 cup organic pumpkin puree
1 tsp vanilla

Preparation

1 Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit and line a cookie sheet with parchment paper or a silicone mat. Place that baking sheet on top of another baking sheet. 2 Whisk together the flour, brown sugar, cinnamon, ginger, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Set aside. 3 Knead the butter in until it forms small crumbs. Mix in the chocolate chips. Set aside. 4 In a separate bowl mix together the buttermilk, pumpkin and vanilla. Mix into the crumb mix until it forms a dough. 5 On a lightly floured surface knead the dough until it forms a ball. 6 Pat the ball to about 7 inches wide, then cut into 8 - 10 pieces. I used floss to do this. 7 Move the scones to the baking sheet and brush with either an egg wash or heavy cream. 8 Bake 20 minutes, rotating 180 degrees after 10 minutes, or until golden brown. 9 Enjoy immediately - making this recipe perfect for sharing! :)

About

Check out this simple pumpkin scone recipe! Made even more delicious with the addition of mini chocolate chips!
